summary: East Kootenay lookout about 20 miles southwest of Jeffray; a 1955 obituary says B.C. Forest Service man F.B.M. Peterson manned it for 27 years; listed as removed.

facts.status_note: Canada Lookouts lists the lookout as Removed.

events.note: Obituary dated June 16, 1955 says Peterson had manned the lookout for 27 years and was waiting to return to it for that season.

evidence.supports: Lookout is in the Cranbrook District of East Kootenay
Obituary is credited on the page to The Lethbridge Herald
Lookout on a mountaintop 20 miles southwest of Jeffray; manned for 27 years by Peterson
evidence.quote: for 27 years had manned the lonely isolated Caven lookout station on a mountaintop 20 miles southwest of Jeffray

evidence.supports: Peterson was a longtime B.C. Forest Service employee
evidence.quote: He was a longtime B.C. Forest Service employee

evidence.supports: Peterson was a key man in the Elko ranger district during the fire season
evidence.quote: as a key man in the Elko ranger district during the fire season

evidence.supports: Peterson died at Fernie Hospital after his jeep plunged down a bank near his farm south of Elko
evidence.quote: died Sunday at Fernie Hospital after his jeep plunged down a 50-foot bank in the vicinity of his farm south of Elko

evidence.supports: He was waiting at the Elko ranger station to return to the lookout for the season
evidence.quote: He had been working recently at the Elko ranger station waiting for trail conditions to allow his return to his lookout post for this season.

notes_for_editor: One source: the Canada Lookouts page, which quotes a 16 June 1955 obituary from The Lethbridge Herald. The obituary was not checked at the newspaper. The staffing date is the obituary year, not a known first or last season. The Removed status has no date or detail. A Facebook group post asks whether the Caven lookout is still standing, which suggests the removal is not independently confirmed; the post is not cited. Two searches found no other Caven source. Brief coordinates, elevation and district match the page; brief status gone is consistent with Removed. Elevation unit is not written on the page and is read as metres, as in the brief's elevation_m field.
